about_the_game: The demo let's you play 3 full runs until your team is eliminated, good luck! All progression is saved from the demo and lets you continue with the full game.

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content.

detailed_description: The demo let's you play 3 full runs until your team is eliminated, good luck! All progression is saved from the demo and lets you continue with the full game.
name: 7 Minutes in Hell Demo
short_description: 7 Minutes in Hell is a co-operative horror game, where 1-4 contestants must face Arenas filled with traps and monsters. In this gameshow styled experience, work together to hunt for loot and internet fame, while escaping before your 7 minutes are up!
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese, Turkish
*languages with full audio support
